name: Luci
source:
Works as a casino host at Wonderland. He may seem sensitive, but nothing actually gets under his skin all that much. Claims to love taking long vacations, but hardly ever leaves the island. 

[From the [url=https://romanesque.site/en/]official website[/url]]
